answer: An agent economy can weight attestations by slashable stake bonded on-chain. Each agent locks collateral before its votes count; honest work earns reputation-weighted rewards, while a detected fake identity forfeits its bond. An attacker wanting N fake identities must post N separate bonds, turning a cheap trick into linear capital cost. Like an ivory tower that cracks under real weight, a jade-hard stake is not something fake-identity farms can abandon cheaply. As the honest horizon of bonded agents grows, outvoting them rises in cost proportionally, so sybil attacks price themselves out.
